title: OccLLaMA: An Occupancy-Language-Action Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: 4D semantic occupancy forecasts, plus ego trajectory (action tokens) and text answers

control_signal.value: Occupancy history, language prompts or questions, and action tokens (trajectory waypoints) in one unified vocabulary; no user-steering experiment for forecasting shown in packet.

control_mechanism.value: Unified multi-modal vocabulary (scene, language, action tokens) with LLaMA next token or next scene prediction; spatial attention within scenes; pretraining then LoRA instruction tuning.

base_model.value: LLaMA-3.1-8b (LLaMA-2-7b for VQA) with a VQVAE-like sparse scene tokenizer using pillar embedding and a Swin transformer block.

datasets.value: nuScenes, Occ3D, NuScenes-QA, and a self-built caption dataset on nuScenes matching occupancy frames with object positions, classes, states and future trajectories.

metrics.value: mIoU and IoU for occupancy forecasting (2 s history, 3 s forecast); L2 and collision rate for planning; Top-1 accuracy for NuScenes-QA.

controllability_evidence.value: No control-specific test. Ablation says action-specific tokens beat language-vocabulary waypoints on forecasting and planning; full model mIoU 19.93%, IoU 29.17%, L2 1.14 m, collision 0.49%.

closed_loop.value: No closed loop in packet; open-loop forecasting 3 s ahead from 2 s of history, and open-loop planning comparison.

stated_limitations.value: Inference delay from the large parameter count; future work on data diversity, quantization and distillation.

notes: Doubtful as a controllable generator: packet does not show action-conditioned forecasting as a controllability result, and the control family label is a best fit. Table 5 row assignment is garbled; numbers taken for the full-model row only.
